items.title: Inside Demna's Generation Gucci Campaign (Vogue Philippines August 2026 issue)
items.summary: Vogue Philippines' August 2026 print issue features Demna's 'Generation Gucci' lookbook (84 portraits, models including Alex Consani, Gabbriette, Elsa Hosk), shot in part by Filipino photographer JV Rabano at Manila locations (Vestido the Studio, WILD Cafe, TREEHOUSE). Piece frames Gucci as a cross-generational cultural language and highlights updated Jackie, Dionysus, Giglio and Paparazzo bags. Local angle: a Philippine creative directly involved in the brand's global campaign rollout.

items.title: Fake Gucci, Hermes goods expose counterfeit fashion network in Vietnam
items.summary: Vietnamese authorities uncovered a nationwide counterfeit network (Phu Tho, Can Tho, Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Khanh Hoa, Lang Son) selling fake Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci, Hermes, Nike and other branded goods via shops, warehouses and social platforms (Facebook, Zalo, TikTok, Shopee). Single seizures ranged from ~VND380 million to VND3.4 billion in counterfeit goods; total illicit profits described as tens of billions of dong. Critical-angle signal: highlights how pervasive Gucci counterfeiting is in the Vietnamese market and the scale of enforcement needed.

items.title: Gucci HCMC Facebook post engagement snapshot
items.summary: Recent post on Gucci's official Ho Chi Minh City Facebook page (own-channel, not independent commentary) showed moderate organic engagement, consistent with steady but unspectacular local social reach for the brand's Vietnam page versus regional competitor pages.

items.source: Kering H1 2026 results coverage (WWD/Bloomberg via Citi note)
items.title: Kering H1/Q2 2026: Gucci comparable sales decline narrows to 2%, Asia-Pacific ex-Japan flat at 30% of group revenue
items.summary: Kering's Q2 2026 results (reported July 28) showed Gucci's comparable sales decline slowing to 2%, its best sequential performance in several quarters, driven partly by new handbag launches. Asia-Pacific excluding Japan held flat at roughly 30% of group revenue. Citi subsequently raised its Kering price target to EUR282 (from EUR266) on August 17 while keeping a neutral rating, citing margin caution. Included for regional financial context on Gucci's APAC trajectory even though the announcement itself is dated; flagged as borderline-fresh and retained only for the APAC revenue-share data point, not as a same-week story.
